backup.section.title: Notebox backup
backup.section.intro: Periodically writes a zip archive of the currently-open notebox (and, optionally, your user settings) to a destination of your choice. Backups run while the app is open. You can also trigger a backup any time from the command palette ({modifier} + P → “Back up notebox now”).
backup.destination.label: Destination folder
backup.destination.description: Where archives are written. Leave empty to disable backups entirely.
backup.destination.cannotUseNotebox: Cannot use the notebox folder (or a subfolder of it) as a backup destination — backups would archive themselves.
backup.interval.label: Backup interval (hours)
backup.interval.description: How often to back up while the app is running. 0 disables scheduled backups (manual runs still work).
backup.keepCount.label: Keep how many backups
backup.keepCount.description: Older archives matching the filename pattern are pruned after each successful backup.
backup.onlyOnChange.label: Only back up when something changed
backup.onlyOnChange.description: Skip the scheduled backup if no notebox file has been modified since the last successful run. Manual runs always proceed.
backup.includeUserConfig.label: Include user settings folder
backup.includeUserConfig.description: Bundle your global InkyCap settings (theme, fonts, creation rules, bookmarks) alongside the notebox. Useful when restoring on a new machine.
backup.filenamePattern.label: Filename pattern
backup.filenamePattern.description: Template for each archive. Tokens: {tokens}. Reserved characters are replaced with _.
backup.password.label: Password protection (AES-256)
backup.password.description: When set, archives are encrypted with AES-256. The password is stored in your OS keychain (Secret Service on Linux, Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows) and never written to the settings file.
backup.password.unrecoverableWarning: ⚠ If you lose this password, the backup is unrecoverable. There is no reset.
backup.password.cleared: Password cleared. Future backups will be unencrypted.
backup.lastBackup.label: Last backup
backup.runNow.paletteHint: Or trigger from the command palette ({modifier} + P → “Back up notebox now”).
backup.toast.skipped: Backup skipped (no changes since last run).
backup.browse.title: Browse backups
backup.browse.intro: Choose a backup archive to restore your entire notebox or selected files.
backup.browse.noArchives: No backup archives found in the destination folder yet.
backup.browse.targetOriginalDisabled: Open a notebox to restore in place
backup.browse.noPassword: This archive is encrypted but no password is set in the OS keychain. Re-enter your password above before restoring.
